column27: Lack of information about allocation concealment. While baseline balance is adequate and no systematic imbalances are noted, the absence of clear information on both sequence generation and allocation concealment introduces potential risk of selection bias.
column29: While the intention-to-treat analysis is appropriate, the lack of monitoring or reporting of intervention fidelity/adherence introduces uncertainty about whether actual micromovement was consistently delivered. This could bias results if deviation rates differed between groups.
